title: The Merchant of Oil
logline: The thieves' leader, disguised as an oil merchant, hides his men in jars in Ali Baba's courtyard; Morgiana hears a whisper from a jar, keeps her head, and with neighbours and the town guard has the trap waiting when he gives his signal.
moral: A calm, clever head and good neighbours beat a hidden enemy.
tone: Night suspense played lightly: warm and coloured moonlit courtyard, whispering and tiptoeing, comic near-misses, no harm to anyone; 80s cel anime with wide views, pans across full sets and English speech balloons.

beats.summary: The stranger asks for a safe yard for his jars; Ali Baba welcomes him in.
The merchant is the leader of the thieves in disguise.
The silver ring with the split blue stone, the series clue.
Five jars hold men; only one holds oil.
Morgiana hears a whisper from a jar: IS IT TIME?
She stands still and understands the jars.
She answers as the leader: NOT YET.
In the kitchen she thinks of the sleeping household.
She wakes trusted neighbours and sends for the guards.
Guards at both gates; the yard is sealed in silence.
Nobody answers: every lid is held down.
He opens the door and sees guards and neighbours waiting.
He escapes over the back wall, leaving his disguise behind.
The men are let out and led to the judge.
The leader plans his return; to be continued.

subtitles.ar: قال الرجل لعلي بابا: | «أنا تاجر زيت، وأحتاج إلى ساحة آمنة لجراري هذه الليلة». | رحب به علي بابا، وسمح له بوضع الجرار في فناء البيت.
subtitles.en: The man told Ali Baba, | “I am an oil merchant, and I need a safe courtyard for my jars tonight.” | Ali Baba welcomed him and allowed him to place the jars in the yard.

subtitles.ar: كان الرجل قائد اللصوص متنكرًا، | وفي يده خاتم فضي بحجر أزرق مشقوق. | أخفى رجالًا داخل معظم الجرار، وترك الزيت في جرة واحدة.
subtitles.en: The man was the disguised thieves’ leader. | He wore a silver ring with a split blue stone | and had hidden men in most jars, leaving oil in just one.

subtitles.ar: خرجت مرجانة إلى الفناء تبحث عن زيت للمصباح، فسمعت صوتًا خافتًا من إحدى الجرار يقول: | «هل حان الوقت؟» توقفت دون حركة، ثم فهمت أن الجرار ليست عادية.
subtitles.en: Morgiana went into the yard seeking lamp oil and heard a whisper from one jar: | “Is it time?” She stopped moving and realized that the jars were not ordinary.

subtitles.ar: أجابت مرجانة بصوت منخفض: «ليس بعد». ثم انتقلت بحذر إلى جرة أخرى، وسمعت السؤال نفسه. | أسرعت إلى المطبخ لتفكر في طريقة تحمي أهل البيت.
subtitles.en: Morgiana whispered back, “Not yet.” She moved carefully to another jar and heard the same question. | She hurried to the kitchen to think of a way to protect the household.

subtitles.ar: أيقظت مرجانة بعض الجيران الموثوقين، وطلبت من أحدهم إحضار حرس البلدة. | أغلقوا أبواب الفناء بهدوء ووقفوا قرب الجرار، من غير أن يلفتوا انتباه الرجال.
subtitles.en: Morgiana woke trusted neighbors and asked one to fetch the town guards. | They quietly closed the courtyard gates and stood near the jars without attracting the men’s attention.

subtitles.ar: وصل الحراس خفية، ووزعوا أنفسهم عند البوابتين لمنع اللصوص من الهرب. | وظلت مرجانة تراقب الجرار من نافذة المطبخ، حتى أعطى القائد إشارته.
subtitles.en: The guards arrived quietly and took positions at both gates to prevent the thieves from escaping. | Morgiana watched the jars from the kitchen window until the leader gave his signal.

subtitles.ar: حين أعطى القائد إشارته، | لم يجبه أحد. فتح الباب، فرأى الحراس والجيران ينتظرون حول الفناء.
subtitles.en: When the leader gave his signal, | nobody answered. He opened the gate and saw guards and neighbors waiting around the courtyard.

subtitles.ar: تسلق القائد جدارًا خلفيًا وهرب، لكن رجاله بقوا محاصرين في الجرار. | أخرجهم الحراس بحذر واقتادوهم إلى القاضي. | وظل القائد يخطط للعودة.
subtitles.en: The leader escaped over a back wall, but his men remained trapped in the jars. | Guards carefully let them out and took them to the judge. | The leader kept planning his return.

new_assets.name: jarCutaway and jarPeek (oilJar fields)
new_assets.description: Two additions to the series oilJar. jarCutaway {open 0..1, oil, ghost}: the jar front fades to a warm dark oval 90 x 190 showing a crouched man (person sit floor at s 0.62, any abMan palette) or golden oil to the shoulder with a rocking surface; ghost draws only a cyan outline of the man over the closed jar. jarPeek {lift 0..1, gaze, head}: the lid rises up to 26, with two white eyes in the dark gap at lift 0.3, and at lift 1 the man's head and shoulders up through the mouth wearing the lid as a hat.
new_assets.implementation: Cutaway: draw the jar, then ctx.clip an ellipse inside the body, fill #3a2430, draw the figure inside the clip (feet at the jar foot + 20), then the jar rim over it; alpha of the clip layer = open. Peek: lid ellipse translated up by lift * 26 and tilted 6 degrees; gap rect in #2a1a24 with two ell() eyes and dot pupils offset by gaze; head: draw the person clipped above the rim line, lid on the head at headTop.

owner_questions: The film ends on TO BE CONTINUED... instead of THE END because the leader escapes and plans his return (series decision for episodes that end mid-story); default: TO BE CONTINUED....
The number of jars is six (five with men, one with oil), matching the three mules with two jars each drawn in episode 3, instead of the forty of the traditional tale; default: six.

Family-friendly staging: no boiling oil and no harm; the hidden men are kept in by neighbours sitting on or pressing the lids, helped out gently, roped loosely and walked to the judge; default: as described.
The leader's signal, which the script does not describe, is staged as small pebbles tossed from the guest room shutter onto the jar lids; default: pebbles.

Invented English balloon and label lines: I AM AN OIL MERCHANT., A SAFE YARD FOR MY JARS?, WELCOME!, THE LEADER OF THE THIEVES!, WAIT FOR MY SIGNAL., MEN 5 OIL 1, IS IT TIME?, NOT YET., FETCH THE GUARDS!, SHHH!, GATE 1, GATE 2, TIK! TIK!, CAUGHT!, UH OH., TO THE JUDGE!, I WILL RETURN.; default: kept as written.
Morgiana answers NOT YET while comically imitating the leader (scarf pulled across her chin like a beard, gruff stance); default: included.
When the leader climbs the wall the captain is left holding his brown cloak and white turban, so he escapes in his own indigo and crimson; default: included (it makes the unmasking visible).

Additions beyond the script: Ali Baba appearing sleepy in a nightshirt at the reveal, the baker's stopped sneeze, the cat as a witness, Morgiana finally filling her lamp from the one real oil jar, and the leader watching from a roof above the arch as his men are led away; default: all included.

New recurring neighbours: a big gentle baker and his young apprentice (door 1) beside the old neighbour from episode 3 (door 2); guards in sky blue and brass with a white-caped captain; default: these designs.
The reveal of the disguise in paragraph 2 is shown as a band of moonlight inside which the merchant is drawn as the leader, and the men in the jars as a cutaway view; default: as described.

Frame order: S.background, S.box panel, plate (and cross-fade), live set parts (doors, gate leaves, windows, lanterns, moon, trees), jars (back pass), cels, jar front passes and lids, light (abGlow, abBands, rims), lettering, transition, subtitle, S.finish last.

Pose every character at tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) (12 fps); blinks, lip flaps and the jar eyes at celStep(t, 8). Camera, plate cross-fades, the moon, lantern glow, glints, counters, the light band and the tape transition run on every frame.

Word cues with w(p, n) from timing.json; every cue time in this plan is a word start from inputs/timeline.md. Subtitle chunks are those of chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt, already timed in timing.json; use it unchanged.
